extraction.notes: AVB reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Q4 2024 column used. Dash entries (Distributions to noncontrolling interests, Casualty loss on real estate, Joint venture promote, Loss on extinguishment, Executive transition) recorded as 0. Shares 142,705,114 divided by 1,000 to match thousands units; check: 399,386/142,705.114 = 2.80 and 374,798/142,705.114 = 2.63. Core FFO sum verified to 399,386. Categories for SIP loan reserve, advocacy contributions, other real estate activity, condo imputed carry cost and income tax set to 'other'. Same reconciliation also appears on seq 40 (printed 24); seq 11 used as the source. The 'Unconsolidated entity losses (gains), net' line is described in footnote (1) as primarily net unrealized gains on technology investments.
